intro: Proton, GE-Proton and Wine builds detected on this system.
about: A runner is the build that runs a Windows game on Linux. Each game picks one in its settings; native Linux games need none.
defaultSaved: {{runner}} is the default for games set to Automatic
defaultAutomatic: Games set to Automatic pick the best runner again
emptyBody: No Proton or Wine builds found. Install Proton from Steam, or drop GE-Proton into ~/.steam/root/compatibilitytools.d.
removeInUse: {{count}} game(s) still use it; switch them first or remove anyway
offline: You're offline; connect to list installable runners.

atlas.defaultDesc: Games set to Automatic run it; each game can still pick its own.
